summary: Users, teams, organizations, memberships and common roles move from controller 2.4 to platform gateway 2.6, and controller admins become gateway admins; migration time grows with data, for example 4,000 users, 400 teams and 40 organizations take close to two hours.
questions: How long does the AAP 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade take?
Do controller admins become platform admins after upgrade?
What IAM data moves to platform gateway?
